items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: To me Charlie Parker and Louis Armstrong and Duke Ellington are — what do you call them — the beacons of the music?

ctx.x: We didn’t call him Louie, we called him Gino. That’s ‘cause his parents called him Gino. He lived near me.
